tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po pad+ma dbang phyug las sngon 'gro gtor ma bya ba dang: srung 'khor sgom zhing mtshams bcad pa ni:1$0000300 rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug to nam mkha' la phyar zhing: g.yon sdigs mdzub sdigs pa'i tshul gyis thugs kar mdzad pa: khro tshul gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs kyis pad+ma nyi zla kha sbyor du bsnol ba'i steng na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs skad cig gis bkug la:

dkar gtor zlum po pad+ma 'dab ma gsum pa gcig la chang bdud rtsis bran la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsreg gtor sbyang dang byin rlabs tshul bzhin byas te: gtor ma bsngo ba ni: oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+yan nut+pan+na twā da oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: de ltar lan bdun gyis bsngos nas ni: puṣ+pe nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod: phrin las bcol ba ni: hrī: sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs: dngos su bshams pa'i mchod sbyin bdud rtsi'i rgyun: 'dzad pa med par byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul: 'di dag gsol zhing bde bar bsnams nas kyang: sa phyogs dge zhing bar chad med pa dang: ji srid snying po'i 'bras bu ma thob bar: khyed rnams sa phyogs gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: gal te 'dir gnas bsam sbyor ngan pa yis: las la mi mthun 'bras bu 'byin gyur na: bdag nyid dbang chen dpal gyi mthu stobs kyis: lus ngag yid gsum thal ba bzhin du byed: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: badz+ra bid+yā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de ltar bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor gyis mtshams bcad pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid dbang chen rta mgrin khros pa yi: thugs las spros pa'i mtshon cha rdo rje me: steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus kun tu bskor: bskal pa las kyi rlung yang ldang mi 'gyur: oṃ h+ya grī ba badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang gur khang zlum po ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa bsgom pa'o: sprul sku shes rab 'od zer gyis gter nas gdan drangs pa'o// //
